decisions.reason: The green level-four bullet is a separate clause already represented in this Requirement; the caption typography change does not alter bullet design.
The existing deployment rule already requires the prescribed style system across all templates; the caption typography specification does not change that rule or its scope.
Caption typography does not change Tab-based list hierarchy behavior or resolve its existing ambiguity.
The source specifies caption typography but does not change the required PBU style-name prefix or its applicability.
Caption font specifications do not affect numbered-list alignment at double-digit values.
Theme colors are mentioned in a separate clause already represented by this Requirement; the caption typography change does not modify the color-palette requirement.
The caption typography specification does not change the document's default language.
Adding caption typography does not change the existing expected layout or style behavior during legacy-content transfer.
The source does not change the supported Word environment or the requirement for stable rendering across users.
Typography for table labels does not change table containment or layout stability when content is pasted.
Caption typography does not affect the ability to create manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source specifies font properties for image and table labels but does not change their language or the language of style names.
